installer.method: Isolated test identities and synthetic payloads; install/upgrade/uninstall, folder selection, profile retention and mutex checks.

cefMaintenance.selection: Highest stable modern CEF version in Windows x64 index; index order is not version order.

preparationHistory.result: MSBuild stopped before compilation; ordinary Windows runner used without product policy changes.
CMake regeneration failed after a build label was edited during compilation; final source was held fixed for the successful rebuild.
Connection reset; retry passed verified HTTPS, publisher size/SHA-1 and recorded SHA-256.

limits: Synthetic CEF fixtures and native authentication drivers do not establish physical UI or real-site acceptance.
Regular-release designation does not establish an independent audit or production reliability certification.
Combined inspection validates an interval while page scripts/canvas continue running; timings exclude model inference.
Package and publication evidence is recorded separately after assembly. User installation remains intact.
privacy: Disposable synthetic profiles only; no pairing tokens, raw calls, browsing logs, vault data or screenshots.

autofillFixtureFix: Compile-time-gated, marked-profile AuthTest driver activates only its synthetic window and gives its CEF view native focus; fixed failure-stage codes retain diagnostics without page strings. Production input/autofill policies are unchanged.
autofillFixtureLimit: A later validation attempt lost foreground focus at the unowned-phase picker. Its failed evidence is retained; a fresh isolated rerun is recorded above. Desktop focus remains an external test-runner dependency.
